content:
ada: quick thread: consider a per-dim fastpath budget instead of a single tenant global. some tenants send mixed dims and gaming fastpath for small dims starves larger-dim batches.
ricardo: makes sense. per-dim budget could be simple 'fastpath_units_by_dim' map on tenant profile. defaults: small dims get higher share.
lily: UX question 22how do we surface this?" show top dims and their fastpath usage in the console, with heatmap and an 'increase allocation' flow. also show projected unit burn.
ada: typo lol (meant ada).
infra-bot: quota.update -> tenant=acme-corp, field=fastpath_units_by_dim, delta={"64":1000,"768":200} by ricardo
ada: two infra concerns: 1) telemetry explosion if we tag every request by dim; 2) fairness enforcement in router at scale. we should aggregate dims into buckets (tiny/medium/large) for telemetry and quotas.
ricardo: agree on buckets. propose boundaries: tiny <= 128, medium <= 512, large > 512. routers can check bucket id. simplifies enforcement and console UX.
lily: dashboard needs these tiles: per-bucket p50/p95 latency, fastpath_share, batch_size_histogram, estimated per-1000-units cost delta. also an alert when fastpath_share > 30% for a tenant for >5m.
ops: for rollout, I'd prefer region-limited canary: eu-west first (lower production risk) for 72h, measure SLOs and billing delta, then us-west. add a kill-switch toggle in console.
ada: about sampling: sample 0.1% full payload traces, 5% detailed telemetry events with bucket id and route_variant. store aggregated histograms per tenant-dim-bucket.
ricardo: billing: we add a column `fastpath_adjustment` on invoice lines. internal metric `units_effective = units * fastpath_multiplier` so downstream reporting stays consistent.
infra-bot: capacity.warning -> cluster=embed-prod-1, region=eu-west, metric=fastpath_utilization, val=78%
lily: safe defaults: tenants start with 0 fastpath budget unless approved; console CTA to apply for a trial. avoid scammy apps gaming it.
ada: enforcement detail: router will reserve fastpath_slots per machine to avoid head-of-line blocking; if bucket exhausted, fallback to normal batching. also drop client header if dims unknown or mismatched with claimed dims.
ricardo: sdk snippet for client docs:
```
client = RedwoodEmbeddings(api_key)
client.create_embeddings(["a","b"], dims=768, latency_hint_ms=100)
```
add note: latency_hint only honored if tenant fastpath budget > 0 and header within 10-2000ms.
lily: we'll add a console preview: "simulate fastpath for last 7 days" that replays historical traffic and shows cost/latency delta. good product sell.
ops: add playbook: if fastpath_utilization > 85% for 10m then auto-throttle new fastpath requests and notify infra oncall.
ada: I'll write a short RFC with enforcement pseudocode and aggregation plan. thanks everyone.
infra-bot: event -> trace.sampled embed.req.sample tenant=acme-corp bucket=medium route=fastpath queue_ms=8 batch=2 units=3"
